name: dev.mcpharbor.gateway/usgs_quake
title: USGS Earthquakes
description: USGS earthquake catalog: seismic events, magnitude, real-time feeds and hazard data

compliance.attribution: Not legally required (public domain), but USGS asks that proper credit be given, e.g. 'Credit: U.S. Geological Survey, Department of the Interior/USGS'. Do not imply USGS endorsement.
compliance.notes: search/count accept source=emsc, whose terms were not reviewed, and the source cannot be pinned yet. Excluded under default-deny; re-enable once argument pinning exists.
compliance.reasoning: USGS states that USGS-authored data and information 'are considered to be in the U.S. Public Domain', and the API needs no key or agreement, so commercial relay is unrestricted apart from a courtesy credit request. The USGS docs publish only a 20,000-event query cap and advise automated apps to use the cached GeoJSON feeds; the EMSC option in the MCP server must be excluded because its terms were not reviewed.

evidence.quote: data and information are considered to be in the U.S. Public Domain
we ask that proper credit be given
